dedupe_keys.name: shenzhen reservoir slope dual camera and rtk marker measurements

description: The public Zenodo release pairs two fixed-camera views of a slope near Shenzhen Reservoir with marker pixel positions and RTK three-dimensional reference coordinates. The article describes 589 high-resolution field images, a 48-hour illumination observation of fourteen markers and controlled movement of thirteen markers through five stages. The repository lists five ZIP packages and a guide, with about 6.9 gigabytes of material overall, under CC BY 4.0. These are measurements for evaluating non-contact slope displacement reconstruction, not a recorded landslide or proof of dam structural movement. One natural slope, artificial marker motion, camera geometry and changing illumination are limitations for operational early-warning estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing how accurately a hazard-monitoring component recovers marker displacement before feeding a reservoir-area risk simulation. data-cedd-hk-slopes-landslide-incidents is a related slope hazard resource from a different setting; no event linkage was tested. No image, archive, code or guide file was downloaded.
